description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for handling delivery plans and failure destinations in a cron job system, including normalization and resolution of delivery parameters.

methods.name: normalizeChannel
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a CronMessageChannel or undefined, trimming and converting to lowercase if string.

methods.name: normalizeTo
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a string or undefined, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: normalizeAccountId
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a string or undefined, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: normalizeThreadId
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a string, number, or undefined, handling finite numbers and trimming strings.

methods.name: resolveCronDeliveryPlan
methods.description: Resolves a CronDeliveryPlan object from a CronJob, determining delivery mode, channel, target, and other parameters.

methods.name: resolveFailureDestination
methods.description: Resolves a CronFailureDeliveryPlan based on job delivery failure settings and global configuration.

methods.name: isSameDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Checks if a delivery and failure plan target the same delivery target.
